name: loco
description: A career record your agent can read and write, using the POTS method — Phase, Objectives, Tasks, SEDOs. Bundles the LOCO methodology skill with the hosted MCP server, so one install gives your agent both the tools and the judgement to use them. Captures work as it happens instead of reconstructing it under pressure months later. Your agent proposes; you confirm what's accurate; nothing becomes public unless you publish it yourself — there is deliberately no publish tool. Sign-in happens in your browser on first use.
